style: Comic book panel illustration: bold thick black ink outlines, halftone shading, warm saturated colours (amber, orange, golden yellow, with teal and electric-blue accents), dramatic cinematic lighting with deep shadows, dynamic composition, 16:9 horizontal frame. Generic fictional characters only (no real people, no celebrities, no recognisable faces), no brand names or logos. Absolutely no text, letters, words, numbers or writing anywhere in the image: screens, papers, signs and clocks are blank or show only simple abstract shapes. Leave clean, uncluttered empty space in the upper part of the frame for speech balloons that will be added later.

images.prompt: A packed technology conference hall seen from the back of the audience: rows of excited generic attendees with laptops and phones raised, a huge stage with a giant screen showing only abstract glowing circles and light rays, spotlights sweeping the air, confetti-like sparkles. Empty space at the top for a speech balloon.

Night-time home office: a small friendly glowing round orb character with simple cute eyes floats in front of a floating cloud computer window full of abstract blocks, working busily with little light trails, while its owner sleeps peacefully on a sofa in the background; a window shows a starry city skyline and a wall clock without numerals. Warm lamp light versus cool blue glow. Empty space at the top for a speech balloon.

Dynamic comic action scene: a sleek rocket-shaped cursor streaks across the panel leaving bright speed lines and a trail of glowing abstract blocks, while a startled developer at a desk has their hair blown back by the wind; strong radial motion blur, electric-blue and golden tones. Empty space at the top for a shout balloon.

A relaxed developer sitting at a sunny street café holding a smartphone, launching tasks with a tap; above them a big stylised cloud contains several floating abstract code windows and tiny robot arms building blocks; their closed laptop rests on the table. Warm golden afternoon light with teal accents. Empty space at the top for a speech balloon.

A giant glowing shield with a scanning beam sweeps over a landscape of stacked abstract repository blocks and branching lines; small cartoon bugs flee from the beam while tiny helper robots patch cracks in the blocks. Dramatic dark background with electric-blue and amber light. Empty space at the top for a speech balloon.

A bright modern shared workspace: a diverse team of generic colleagues gathered around a large table with floating translucent documents, slide cards and charts made of abstract shapes, and a small friendly glowing orb character helping them arrange the cards. Warm, optimistic lighting, teal and golden tones. Empty space at the top left and top right for speech balloons.
